sections_en.text: This document sets out the test steps for the protection device mentioned above. The first draft was prepared by Eng. Mahmoud Ahmed Mahmoud at the New Assiut Power Station, Upper Egypt Electricity Production Company; the field test was carried out by Eng. Ali Hussein Farrag and Mahmoud Faisal Mohamed on 19 October 2002.
Fence off the work area and place the warning signs
Follow the occupational safety and health instructions for the safety of personnel and equipment

items: Test comb, Test plug type XRT-1

sections_en.text: Work Steps to be Carried Out
First: Measuring the relay operating current setting value

rows: Remove the relay cover and withdraw the relay contact comb from the CT secondary terminals
Make a direct connection (Jumper) between terminals (15,16) on the Test plug
Place the Test plug in place of the relay contact comb on the CT secondary terminals
Connect the current injection terminals from the Severker 650 set to terminals (5,6) on the Test plug
Switch on the Severker injection set
Raise the current gradually until you notice the relay disc move
Record the relay operating current value
Reduce the current value to zero, then disconnect the Severker injection set

sections_en.text: Second: Measuring the relay operating times

rows: Connect the Stop terminals from the Severker injection set to terminals (1,2) on the Test plug
Switch on the Severker 650 injection set
Set the injection current to (2 x Setting) and measure the current using the Clamp Meter
Reset the time counter display on the Severker injection set
Set the Severker injection set switch to the (ON Time) position
Record the relay operating time corresponding to the current (2 x Setting Value) (note that the Severker injection set disconnects automatically after the relay operates)
Switch on the Severker injection set
Set the injection current to (3 x Setting Value) and measure the current using the Clamp Meter
Reset the time counter display on the Severker injection set
Set the Severker injection set switch to the (ON Time) position
Record the relay operating time corresponding to the current (3 x Setting) (note that the Severker 650 injection set disconnects automatically after the relay operates)
Reduce the current value to zero, then disconnect the Severker injection set
Withdraw the Test plug from the relay
Reset all the signals on the relay
Fit the relay contact comb to the CT secondary terminals

Egyptian Electricity Holding Company
Maintenance Procedures Information System
Maintenance Procedures Information System
 | Protection Devices | Maintenance Procedures
Document No.: EFR-019-r0a | Equipment: Testing of earth leakage protection in the 6.3 kV, 380 V system, x51N ICOID-ATI, Toshiba
Issued to: Assiut Power Station
Status: APPROVED
Approval date: 07 September 2003 | Procedure: Test procedures using Severker
Next review date: September 2003
Introduction
This document sets out the test steps for the protection device mentioned above. The first draft was prepared by Eng. Mahmoud Ahmed Mahmoud at the New Assiut Power Station, Upper Egypt Electricity Production Company; the field test was carried out by Eng. Ali Hussein Farrag and Mahmoud Faisal Mohamed on 19 October 2002.
Safety Precautions
Open the work order
Fence off the work area and place the warning signs
Follow the occupational safety and health instructions for the safety of personnel and equipment
Open the work order
Fence off the work area and place the warning signs
Follow the occupational safety and health instructions for the safety of personnel and equipment
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
Test comb, Test plug type XRT-1
AC V-A voltage measuring instrument, type YOKOGAWA
Clamp meter, type Kew Snap 2002 (KYORITSU) A
Voltage and current injection set, type Severker
Test leads
Test comb, Test plug type XRT-1
Work Steps to be Carried Out
First: Measuring the relay operating current setting value
Remove the relay cover and withdraw the relay contact comb from the CT secondary terminals | 1
Make a direct connection (Jumper) between terminals (15,16) on the Test plug | 2
Place the Test plug in place of the relay contact comb on the CT secondary terminals | 3
Connect the current injection terminals from the Severker 650 set to terminals (5,6) on the Test plug | 4
Switch on the Severker injection set | 5
Raise the current gradually until you notice the relay disc move | 6
Record the relay operating current value | 7
Reduce the current value to zero, then disconnect the Severker injection set | 8
Second: Measuring the relay operating times
Connect the Stop terminals from the Severker injection set to terminals (1,2) on the Test plug | 9
Switch on the Severker 650 injection set | 10
Set the injection current to (2 x Setting) and measure the current using the Clamp Meter | 11
Disconnect the Severker 650 injection set | 12
Reset the time counter display on the Severker injection set | 13
Set the Severker injection set switch to the (ON Time) position | 14
Record the relay operating time corresponding to the current (2 x Setting Value) (note that the Severker injection set disconnects automatically after the relay operates) | 15
Switch on the Severker injection set | 16
Set the injection current to (3 x Setting Value) and measure the current using the Clamp Meter | 17
Disconnect the Severker 650 injection set | 18
Reset the time counter display on the Severker injection set | 19
Set the Severker injection set switch to the (ON Time) position | 20
Record the relay operating time corresponding to the current (3 x Setting) (note that the Severker 650 injection set disconnects automatically after the relay operates) | 21
Reduce the current value to zero, then disconnect the Severker injection set | 22
Withdraw the Test plug from the relay | 23
Reset all the signals on the relay | 24
Fit the relay contact comb to the CT secondary terminals | 25
Fit the relay cover | 26
